title: feat(research): release the T740 R1 cap composition
body:
## Summary

```text
PR3024 T740 allocation + PR3015 R1 words
  -> materialized order, dispatch and 2,717,280 literal roles
  -> fresh source/native/admission/modern-outer release
```

Complete PR3024's released T740 handoff. The complete conditional moment root is about `0.001729152756004331`, approximately `1.5520e-9` above PR3021. The changed R1 tariff is recertified against all 2,551 packing patterns. The complete physical stock, 91 private buffers, larger parent and prefix reserve remain charged.

Only `research/rank7-t740-release/` is added. [Proof, exact sources, receipts and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/78e77d820393c6b8648b47af219e991edfcc54e6/research/rank7-t740-release). The canonical investigation is https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18980805. Concurrent [PR3028](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3028) reports the separate T148 release. This larger-stock T740 endpoint exceeds its reported endpoint by about `4.1886e-10`; that comparison is not an independent review of PR3028. No selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3024 has a finite cap-attaining allocation but no T740 supplier/outer release. **After:** fresh retained bootstrap, both edited native providers, strict discovery, complete admission and modern outer release pass. Conditional `kappa = 0.001729152756004330934535 - 10^-46 - 10^-70`; exact gain over PR3021 is `1552021312491537/10^24`.
- The full-stock arithmetic gives 663,549 physical families and a 1,512-bit reserve below the charged 2,048 bits. Every literal role passes an independent owner engine.
- Recorded full-replay stages total 1,751.78 seconds. Registered finite replay, eight behavioral groups, optimized controls, warnings-as-errors and Ruff pass. Six stored-receipt corruption controls also pass. Source pins and all nine Git export paths are checked. All 81 committed package/input byte checks pass. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-t740-release
```

Credit Jeremy Kothe/R1, Nick Petalas/PR3018/3021/3024, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Mason Hale, Jeremy Diviney, Yiyang Lu, Tekalign, Ross Richardson, Dugongue, icekylinx, themilkman216 and the retained geometry/native/owner lineage. Substantial automated assistance; no independent human or formal-kernel review claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

One additive research package. No frozen source, shared checker, selected result, or other PR disposition changes. All-size/compiler, native/dirty-state realization, physical backing/movement, precision/tape, caller, analytic and universal block-energy hypotheses remain inherited. This is a conditional finite certificate.
